notes: STATIC re-estimation of Table 11(a) column (5) (Sponsored): single post indicator post_lt = 1{interval_lt >= 1} = two_weeks_since_last + after_two_weeks_last, replacing the two published bins. published_coef is null; the closest comparators are authors_code.bin_0_2_coef / bin_3plus_coef. Authors' regression (line 114): reghdfe sponsored_dummy two_weeks_since_last after_two_weeks_last, absorb(id time_week) cluster(id); no controls, no weights. Table 11(a): two post bins relative to the product's LAST Facebook recruitment post (END of the promotion), interval_lt in [1,3] (two_weeks_since_last, labelled '<= 2 wks') and interval_lt in [4,8] (after_two_weeks_last, labelled '> 2 wks'), generated at do-file lines 77-80; reference = focal weeks interval_lt in [-4,0] plus all comparison-product weeks. Sample (line 85): focal weeks interval_lt in [-4,8] (1,491 focal products) plus all 108 weeks of comparison products; 259,148 rows before outcome NAs. Onset g = first time_week with post_lt = 1 (interval_lt = 1): 37 cohorts, weeks 515-551; 11 focal products have no interval_lt >= 1 row in the window and enter as never-treated (no effect on TWFE). Data quirk: time_week is the year-week of each 7-day interval, so within a product the calendar offset time_week - interval varies by one week for about a quarter of focal rows, and 14% of rows share a product-week with another row (focal and comparison products alike). reghdfe/fixest accept this. gvar = onset calendar week computed on all rows of the window (so it does not move with outcome missingness); sample_filter tie_drop == 0 drops 118 rows with interval just before onset that fall in the onset calendar week (the switch-off rule run_spec applies to treat_var specs), moving the single-post TWFE from 0.02971 (authors' rows) to 0.03030 (run_spec rows); on the remaining rows 1{time_week >= g} equals the authors' post indicator exactly. Because of the duplicate product-weeks, the CSA step, when it is under the size guard, goes through did::att_gt with panel = FALSE (repeated cross-section), not the composition-fixed cells. Published table values are not available in the project (no article text or PDF); authors_code fields are the authors' code re-run on the package data. SECONDARY ONSET (lead's ruling): treatment timing is the END of the Facebook promotion, a second timing definition for the same products as Table 10(a); the pre-period for focal products is the active-promotion phase. Main-text status unverified: Table 13 is Appendix D and Tables 12, 14, 15 are robustness checks, so Tables 10-11 may be appendix tables. in_abstract_intro unverified (stored abstract is one sentence).
